title: Unit types offering a leadership position
description: The unit groupings the Scouts BSA rank requirements use when listing positions of responsibility. `crew_or_ship` is deliberately one code, not two: the requirement prints a single 'Venturing crew/Sea Scout ship' heading over one list, and splitting it would assert a distinction the source does not make. Single-valued codes on position.unit_types, which is an array because six positions appear under more than one heading.

terms.label: Scout Troop
terms.description: Positions in a Scouts BSA troop, from Patrol Leader to Outdoor Ethics Guide.

terms.label: Venturing Crew / Sea Scout Ship
terms.description: Positions the requirements list under a single combined heading for Venturing crews and Sea Scout ships, including ship-specific roles such as Boatswain and Purser.
